{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reload the data to ensure clean state
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Strip commas from revenue column to handle thousands separators
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)

# Cast to float
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue_clean'].astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
test_order_mask = (sales['revenue_float'] == 999999.99)

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = (sales['status'] == 'refunded')

# Identify completed orders
completed_mask = (sales['status'] == 'completed')

# Filter valid completed orders: completed AND not test order
valid_completed_mask = completed_mask & ~test_order_mask

# Compute total revenue from valid completed orders
total_revenue = sales.loc[valid_completed_mask, 'revenue_float'].sum()

# Output the result
total_revenue"}
